newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - May 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Privatisation of oil refinery Samir Oil and Societe Cherifienne des Petroles will support current budget despite previous worries over delays in concluding selloff.
- Customs code not included in this year's budget so it complies with international standards and avoids problems of last year's crackdown on smuggling.
- Brokers relieved by stocks' downward corrections, saying market was so volatile they positioned shareholders in bonds to limit risks.
- Housing crisis is not result of low production but of high interest rates which make loans inaccessible to people with low incomes.
- Morocco should focus on skills rather than low salaries among ways to attract foreign investment as it registers lower amounts compared with countries like Tunisia, Turkey or Egypt.
